purpose: Teach: 技師/舗装/練り/降ろし/耐震/ドラッグ/併用/学位

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、技師、絶対、増員、絶対、しましょう
lines.en: Let's seriously commit to expanding our engineering team — it's absolutely necessary.
lines.style: Measured, purposeful delivery. Direct eye contact. Slight emphasis on the commitment. Clear cadence, no hesitation. The tone of someone who has thought this through and is ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社屋前、本気で、絶対、舗装、絶対、補修、絶対、終わりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The parking lot paving repair is complete, and we're genuinely grateful for the effort.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, slightly relieved. Natural nod in the voice. Steady pace. A touch of sincerity — not just compliance, but genuine appreciation breaking through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 販促案、本気で、絶対、練り、絶対、なおしましょう
lines.en: Let's refine and improve our marketing proposal. We need to get this right.
lines.style: Focused directive, slightly forward-leaning. Collaborative tone — not commanding, but guiding. Measured pace with a quiet confidence. The energy of someone who sees the work ahead and is ready.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、価格、絶対、降ろし、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently reviewing pricing strategies to see where we can offer better value.
lines.style: Professional update, slightly careful. Measured delivery — weighing each point as he speaks. A hint of pride that progress is being made. Steady, transparent.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、耐震、絶対、補強、絶対、社屋、絶対、しましょう
lines.en: We need to prioritize seismic reinforcement for the building. This is important.
lines.style: Direct and serious. Slight weight on the opening. No rush — each phrase lands clearly. The tone of someone raising something that matters. Calm but firm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、ドラッグ、絶対、ストアと、絶対、提携、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively pursuing a partnership with the drugstore chain, and we've prepared the staff education subsidy framework as well.
lines.style: Comprehensive update delivered with quiet momentum. Confident rhythm — showing progress on multiple fronts. A sense of accomplishment without overstatement. Warm closing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: TV広告、本気で、絶対、併用、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move ahead with concurrent television advertising. That's our next step.
lines.style: Clear direction with forward momentum. Slight lift in the cadence — this is the move she wants to make. Confident but not forceful. The tone of strategic decision-making.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、学位、絶対、取得、絶対、補助金、絶対、整えました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've arranged the staff education subsidies and we're supporting degree acquisition. Thank you for your leadership on this.
lines.style: Comprehensive closing update, slightly grateful. Smooth delivery that encompasses multiple completed items. A touch of warmth — acknowledging the weight of her direction. Professional but genuinely warm.
